name: ai-frontend-design-workflow
description: Design-first frontend workflow (dfw) for Claude Code, plus pinned, de-conflicted copies of the design skills it orchestrates.

scripts.lint: npm run lint:eslint && npm run lint:format && npm run lint:types
scripts.format: prettier --write core/studio scripts tests/e2e tests/unit tests/golden/*.mjs tests/bench/*.mjs eslint.config.js types
scripts.lint:eslint: eslint core/studio scripts tests/e2e tests/unit tests/golden/*.mjs tests/bench/*.mjs eslint.config.js
scripts.lint:format: prettier --check core/studio scripts tests/e2e tests/unit tests/golden/*.mjs tests/bench/*.mjs eslint.config.js types
